description: This source file defines the static class CertificateLoader which provides functionality to load and validate X509 certificates from a certificate store, especially for use in TLS authentication scenarios. It includes methods for filtering certificates based on their private key and extended key usage extensions to determine if they are suitable for server or client authentication.

classes.name: CertificateLoader
classes.description: A static utility class providing methods to load X509 certificates from the store with criteria for usage in TLS server or client authentication.

methods.name: LoadFromStoreCert
methods.description: Loads a certificate by subject name from a specified store, filtering by validity, private key accessibility, and allowed usage for server or client authentication.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForServerAuth
methods.description: Determines if a certificate is permitted for server authentication based on its extended key usage extensions.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForClientAuth
methods.description: Determines if a certificate is permitted for client authentication based on its extended key usage extensions.

methods.name: IsCertificateAllowedForKeyUsage
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's extended key usage extensions include a specific purpose OID.

methods.name: DoesCertificateHaveAnAccessiblePrivateKey
methods.description: Verifies if the certificate has an accessible private key.

methods.name: DisposeCertificates
methods.description: Disposes of all certificates in a collection except the specified one.
